notes: Deploy MarginaliaPages from src/MarginaliaPages.sol on Ethereum mainnet, using the existing MarginaliaHook of launch 1283 and IdentityMD Intake and oracle signer. The action argument is bytes32('oracle.request@oracle-1'), UTF-8 right-padded with zeros. Pages are nontransferable and trade on the uncapped linear IMD curve with BASE 0.1 IMD and a 10% trade fee: 90% of the fee pays the issuer or handle escrow, 5% queues permissionless bounded MARG purchases through burnPending with an on-chain per-block sqrt-price bound of 0.5% and sends MARG to the burn address, and 5% funds the hook's pools. Handle claims use Intake-delivered IdentityMD Oracle v2 attestations, a panel of 5, quorum 4, MAX_PRICE 1 IMD, ANSWER_DEADLINE 3 days and CLAIM_WINDOW 90 days. Successful callbacks record the payee and payout; anyone may call settleClaim to release escrow and any oracle-price reimbursement, while subsequent trades pay the payee directly. The constructor stores its four supplied values without external calls. The application has no owner, pause or upgrade authority.
